description: Defines the HttpAuthHandler interface for handling various HTTP authentication schemes (basic, digest, NTLM, Negotiate) within the Chromium project. Includes method declarations for initializing from challenges, generating auth tokens, and handling challenges.

classes.name: HttpAuthHandler
classes.description: Interface class for handling HTTP authentication schemes, providing methods for initialization, token generation, and challenge handling.

methods.name: InitFromChallenge
methods.description: Initializes the handler with a server challenge, storing relevant info for authentication.

methods.name: HandleAnotherChallenge
methods.description: Handles server/proxy challenges after an initial attempt, determining if further challenge-response rounds are needed.

methods.name: GenerateAuthToken
methods.description: Generates an authentication token, possibly asynchronously, for HTTP requests.

methods.name: NeedsIdentity
methods.description: Indicates if the handler requires an identity to generate auth tokens.

methods.name: AllowsDefaultCredentials
methods.description: Checks if default credentials can be used for the given challenge.

methods.name: AllowsExplicitCredentials
methods.description: Indicates if explicit user credentials can be used with this handler.
